name: Ford Mustang Mach-E (Mcity) - PROVISIONAL (template/spec values, not measured)
_notes: mass/lf/lr/Iz: from scale or spec sheet (Step 0). tau/delay: fit_steering.py. steering_ratio/Cf/Cr: fit_vehicle.py. weights copied from mkz.json so the MachE tables keep the MKZ tuning feel. 2026-10-20: PROVISIONAL tables generated from template values (no system-ID drives yet). r de-tuned: withoutdelay 16 (stable to ~25 m/s with 0.2 s delay), withdelay 4 (damping >=0.33 to 30 m/s). Regenerate after Tests 1-3. 2026-10-26: first car test (highway route, <=8.3 m/s): lateral correction too weak (ey drifted to +1.6 m -> path-departure stop) and a steady -0.035 rad heading bias. withdelay retuned to r=1, q_ey x4 (k_ey ~ the old MKZ x1.4 setup; damping >=0.33 up to 15 m/s, thin above), heading_offset back to -0.03. 2026-10-26 (2nd drive): lateral good (|ey|~0.05 m on straights) but steering felt aggressive -> q_ey x2 (from x4), plus steer_rate_limit in the launch. 2026-11-20: steering weaved in turns at 6 m/s (S-overshoot, |ey| to 1.3-1.7 m, ~2.7 reversals/s). Drive fit (/mcity/vehicle_control vs steering report, 130 s by-wire): delay 0.03 s, tau 0.094 s, K 1.00 (fit_steering.py; delay below the 0.04 gate, so set to 1 step = 0.04). The old tables assumed delay 0.2/tau 0.15: on the measured plant they had damping ~0.20 at 6 m/s (oscillatory at all speeds). Regenerated with delay 0.04, tau 0.094, withdelay r=2 (damping 0.76 at 6 m/s, >=0.30 up to 25 m/s, stable +80 ms; k_ey 71% of before). Steering ratio and Cf/Cr still template (not enough steady cornering to fit). speed_x reads ~5.9% low (wheel dia ~0.713). 2026-11-20 (manual baseline drive, 261 s): steering ratio 16.0 -> 14.43 from 11 steady windows at 2.4-9.1 m/s (fit rms 0.33 deg), Kus 1.40 deg/g. Cf/Cr fit 38.7k/39.5k N/rad rejected (outside 80k-250k; IMU only ~26 Hz in that bag) -> template kept. Tables unchanged (they are in front-wheel angle); the ratio only scales cmd/meas. 2026-11-20 (3): "steering still sudden" -> steer_filter_tau 0.15 s low-pass on the command (launch); tables regenerated with tau = 0.094 actuator + 0.15 filter = 0.244 (r=2: damping 0.76 at 6 m/s, >=0.60 to 15 m/s). tau here is the LUMPED value: if steer_filter_tau changes, regenerate with tau = 0.094 + filter.

_history.change: withdelay r 4->1, q_ey x4 after first car test
withdelay q_ey x4 -> x2 (smoother steering) after 2nd drive
